out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Handwashing Sink, Designated Use
violations.observation: OBSERVED HANDWASHING SINK BY DISHWASHER TO BE PILED WITH COOKED POTS AND PANS. OBSERVED THE HANDWASHING SINK AT THE BAR WITH A SMALL PLATE INSIDE.
violations.corrective_action: Handsinks are to be used only for washing hands to encourage proper hand washing and to prevent contamination of cleaned hands. CDI: ITEMS REMOVED FROM SINKS. DO NOT USE HANDWASHING SINKS FOR ANYTHING OTHER THAN HANDWASHING.

violations.title: Separation of Raw Animal and RTE Foods
violations.observation: Raw animal food storage, preparation, holding or display conducted in a manner that may cause cross contamination of ready-to-eat food as follows: OBSERVED RAW FISH STORED ON A SHELF ABOVE BREAD IN THE THREE-DOOR STAND UP COOLER.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from cross contamination by separating raw animal foods like poultry, beef, pork, seafood, and eggs from cooked foods, ready-to- eat foods, washed produce, etc during storage, preparation, holding or display. Raw foods shall be stored on shelving units BELOW or SEPARATED from all cooked foods, commercially processed foods, washed produce, leftover foods, etc. CDI: FOOD REARRANGED ACCORDING TO COOKING TEMPERATURE.

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Handwashing Sink, Designated Use
violations.observation: OBSERVED VARIOUS CLEANING AND PERSONAL ITEMS IN THE HANDWASHING SINK ACROSS FROM THREE-VAT SINK.
violations.corrective_action: Handsinks are to be used only for washing hands to encourage proper hand washing and to prevent contamination of cleaned hands. CDI: EVERYTHING CLEARED OUT OF HANDWASHING SINK.

out_items.name: Consumer advisory provided for raw and undercooked food

violations.title: Consumer Advisory for Raw/Undercooked Food, Disclosure
violations.observation: The following raw and/or undercooked foods are provided on the menu, menu board, table tent or brochure without proper disclosure: DERA SPECIAL “BANATU”
violations.corrective_action: The Consumer Advisory shall include a disclosure statement that includes a description of the animal-derived foods as raw/undercooked or identification of the animal-derived foods by asterisking (*) them to a footnote that states that the items are served raw or undercooked, or contain raw or undercooked ingredients. CDI: AN ASTERISK WAS DRAWN ONTO EACH MENU NEXT TO THIS ITEM DURING THE INSPECTION.

out_items.name: Toxic substances properly identified, stored, and used

violations.title: Storage-Personal Care Items
violations.observation: OBSERVED PERSONAL MEDICINES/CARE ITEMS STORED ON TOP OF PLATES IN THE KITCHEN.
violations.corrective_action: All employees' personal care items shall be stored in a way that prevents the contamination of food and food contact surfaces through improper labeling or storage. CDI: ITEMS RELOCATED. PLATE WASHED, RINSED, SANITIZED.

violations.title: Plumbing System, Maintain Good Repair
violations.observation: OBSERVED THE HANDWASHING SINK ACROSS FROM THE THREE-VAT SINK TO HAVE THE WATER TURNED OFF. WHEN WATER WAS TURNED ON TO THE SINK, THE SINK WAS NOT ABLE TO BE TURNED OFF.
violations.corrective_action: A plumbing system shall be maintained in good repair. PLEASE HAVE THIS HANDWASHING SINK REPAIRED SO THAT IT WORKS PROPERLY.

out_items.name: Toilet facilities properly constructed, supplied, and cleaned

violations.title: Covered Receptacle in Women's Toilet
violations.observation: There is no covered refuse container for the disposal of feminine napkins in the ladies room stall.
violations.corrective_action: A toilet room used by females shall be provided with a covered receptacle for sanitary napkins. PLEASE PROVIDE A COVERED TRASH CAN IN BOTH BATHROOMS. REGAL ABYSSINIA RESTAURANT (Inspection Date: 10/07/2025) Page 2 of 3
